content: Dr. Zein Obagi is a board-certified dermatologist and a diplomate of the American Board of Dermatology. He is also a fellow of the American Academy of Dermatology and is licensed to practice medicine in the states of California and Michigan. Dr. Obagi has been in private practice since 1981. From 1980 to 1981, he served as a staff dermatologist at the Naval Hospital in Long Beach, California. Between 1977 and 1980, he completed his dermatology residency at the Naval Hospital in San Diego, California. Prior to that, from 1976 to 1977, he worked as a Naval Medical Officer in Honolulu, Hawaii. From 1975 to 1976, he trained in gynecology at Henry Ford Hospital in Detroit, Michigan. Between 1973 and 1975, he completed a pathology residency at William Beaumont Hospital in Royal Oak, Michigan. From 1972 to 1973, he served as a rotating intern at Deaconess Hospital in Detroit, Michigan. Dr. Obagi earned his medical degree from Damascus Medical School in Syria, where he studied from 1965 to 1972. Since 2006, Dr. Obagi has been the Medical Director of the Obagi Skin Health Institute, located at 270 N. Canon Drive, Suite 100, Beverly Hills, California. From 1994 to 2006, he operated the Obagi Dermatology Medical Clinic at 9033 Wilshire Boulevard, Suite 100, Beverly Hills, California. Additionally, since 1994, he has managed the Obagi Dermatology Medical Clinic at the San Gabriel Annex, located at 140 West Valley Boulevard, Suite 217, San Gabriel, California. Dr. Obagi currently serves as the Medical Director of ZO Skin Health, Inc. In this role, he is responsible for the development of innovative skincare treatments, protocols, and products designed to promote and maintain healthy skin. He is also an active practicing dermatologist and the head of the Obagi Skin Health Institute in Beverly Hills, California. Furthermore, Dr. Obagi is a prolific author and educator, having delivered over 200 lectures on skin health worldwide. For more than 35 years, Dr. Obagi has been a pioneer in the field of skincare, advancing the concept of creating and maintaining healthy skin rather than merely treating skin diseases or damage. He originally developed and introduced to the market some of the most globally recognized brands of physician-dispensed skincare products, including the original Obagi Nu-Derm® system and the Obagi Blue Peel® kit. Currently, as the Medical Director of ZO Skin Health, Dr. Obagi has redefined the concept of skin health by offering comprehensive solutions that bridge the gap between therapeutic treatments and the maintenance of truly healthy skin.
